name: channel
label: Channel
help: The private channel the chart listens on, shown when the chart is opened, such as private-chart-3f9a1c2b7d4e.

options.label: Set the number (KPI or progress), or add a point to a line
Add to the number (a negative number subtracts)
Add to bars or funnel steps, such as one vote
Set bars or funnel steps, or one point per line series

name: number
label: Number
help: The number to set or add. Used by Set the number and Add to the number.

name: labels
label: Bars
help: Each bar or funnel step and its number. Used by Add to bars and Set bars; a new label is added at the end.

name: max
label: Goal
help: The goal of a progress bar, or a fixed top for a line or bar chart. Leave empty to keep it.

name: title
label: Title
help: Leave empty to keep the chart's title.

name: status
label: Status
help: A short status line shown on the chart, up to 40 characters.

name: event
label: Event name
help: Only change this if the chart was opened with another event name.
